title: Airport Lounge Pass
scenario: A link sells lounge passes for half price and asks for passport details.

answers.A: Buy lounge access through the airline, card, or lounge operator.
answers.B: Upload your passport and pay through the discount link.
answers.C: Pay first, then send passport details only if the lounge requests them.
answers.D: Check the offer inside your airline or card account.

explanation: Lounge access rarely needs a passport image at checkout. Verify the seller and share only what the operator genuinely needs.
proTip: Discount plus unnecessary identity data is not a bargain.
